title: The rooms, in a row
logline: All the invented rooms drawn small in a row across one page — the two apartments, Chicago, Lisbon, the office — like a hotel corridor with every door open. Each room in its own light. No one in any. The sequence's index page, drawn.

panels.composition: Five small rooms drawn side by side across one page like a corridor of open doorways: two apartments with water in the windows, an orange hotel room, a shuttered tiled room, an office, each in its own light, all empty.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, five small rooms drawn side by side across one page like open doorways along a corridor, two apartments with water in their windows, an orange hotel room, a shuttered tiled room and an office, each lit differently and all empty, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
